storyTemplate.title: Cinder Crown
storyTemplate.description: After a border fort falls, the player carries one crown token through enemy lines to keep a small kingdom from surrendering blindly.

messages.speaker: Narrator
messages.text:
Smoke hangs low over the collapsed war table.

Darian Holt pushes a blackened crown token into your hand and points toward the broken east gate.

(Darian Holt) "If this reaches Greyhaven, they negotiate. If it does not, they surrender to rumors."
